description: Bulk import documents into a Cosmos DB container. Reads JSONL (one JSON object per line), a JSON array, or stdin. UPSERT by default (idempotent, safe to retry). The partition-key value is derived automatically from each document using the container's partition-key path.
notes: On partial failure the envelope becomes {documentsImported, documentsFailed, failures:[{item,error,code}], status:'partial_failure'} and the exit code is non-zero. Pass --continue-on-error to skip documents missing the partition-key field. Use --mode insert for create-only (fails on duplicate id). Fabric Cosmos is autoscale-only, so create the container first with 'create-container --partition-key /categoryId'. Query the data back with 'cosmos-db-database query --container products --query-text "SELECT * FROM c"' (cross-partition is automatic unless --partition-key is given).
